reason: I'd run the free 30 receipts to see how it works, but $19 a month every month is a lot for a small rental shop when I could put together something like this in n8n with ChatGPT over a weekend. Writing to my own sheet is nice, but it doesn't do anything I can't do myself.
objection: It's a tiny new bot. If it disappears in six months I'm back to building my own anyway, so why not build it now and own it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 caught a real duplicate or wrong total from my staff that I'd have missed, and read their handwritten notes properly, then paying would beat building it myself.
